# hormesis_lettuce_1993.csv

Shoot biomass of lettuce (`weight`) after 21 days of exposure to isobutyl
alcohol (`conc`, mg/L): 14 observations, two at each of seven concentrations.

The values are the `lettuce` data distributed with the `drc` package (Ritz et
al. 2015, `drc` is licensed GPL-2), which credits van Ewijk and Hoekstra (1993)
as the source. This file is `drc::lettuce` written to CSV. No value was
changed, and the values were checked as identical to `drc::lettuce` in `drc`
3.0.1 and 4.0-0.

References

- van Ewijk PH, Hoekstra JA (1993) Calculation of the EC50 and its confidence
  interval when subtoxic stimulus is present. Ecotoxicology and Environmental
  Safety, 25: 25-32. doi: 10.1006/eesa.1993.1003.
- Ritz C, Baty F, Streibig JC, Gerhard D (2015) Dose-response analysis using R.
  PLOS ONE, 10(12): e0146021. doi: 10.1371/journal.pone.0146021.
